references.text: Jacob also had a large family of seventy people who came to Egypt, showing a similar number of descendants.
All those descended from Jacob were seventy persons, the same number of sons that Gideon had.
Abimelech, one of Gideon's sons, mentions his seventy brothers in his speech to the citizens of Shechem.
Abimelech killed his seventy brothers, Gideon's sons, on a single stone.
Jotham refers to his father's seventy sons who were killed by Abimelech.
Solomon had many wives and concubines, an example of Israelite leaders with many women.
The law warned kings against having many wives, which is relevant to Gideon's many women.
